captions.detailed: This 3D model features a swing-arm desk lamp with a dark grey/black finish. It is supported by a vertical C-clamp mount designed to attach to a desk edge, complete with a silver-colored tightening screw. A horizontal swing arm made of parallel bars extends from a rotating joint at the top of the clamp, ending in a conical reflector lamp shade that can tilt up or down.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery Python script for a swing-arm desk lamp. It must include a vertical C-clamp base with a silver tightening screw, a horizontal swing arm connected via a revolute joint, and a conical reflector lamp shade on a tilt joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs three main parts: the clamp base, the horizontal swing arm, and the lamp shade. The clamp base is built using rectangular boxes for the C-shape and cylinders for the screw and pivot joints. The swing arm is created from parallel rectangular bars spaced with small blocks. The lamp shade is modeled by sweeping or lofting a conical profile, which is then hollowed out. These parts are assembled using revolute joints to simulate the rotational and tilting motions.
